detail.longDescription: My org dosent allow Citrix in linux and my only pc is windows so I created a windows container using docker When I connect to the windows using RDP reminna, the Citrix opens and I'm able to login. But when I try to open the workspace, it shows opening and then running but no workspace opens. When I do the same with VNC protocol, the workspace opens but VNC doesn't support mic and I need that for teams. Native System - DGX OS/Ubuntu Docker - Windows ARM
